paite: Nipikal a ani masapen ahong tun in, zingsangpi khomial lai in, han ah Mari Magdalin ava hoh a, hansuang lakkhiaksa in amu hi.
heading: Han Vuak / (Mat 28.1-8; Mar 16.1-8; Luk 24.1-12)

paite: Huchi in atai a, Simon Peter leh nungzui dang, Jesu'n a-itpa kiang ah ahong pai a, "Han a kipan Toupa apaimangpih ua, akoihna uh ka thei kei uh," chi in agen hi.
Huchi in Peter apawt a, nungzui dang toh han lam azuan uhi.
Atai tuak ua; nungzui dang in Peter amakhelh a, han atung masa hi.
Huan kunsuk in a-en a, puanmalngat hoih amu a; himahleh asung ah alut kei hi.
Simon Peter amah nung in ahong tung sam a, han sung ah alutsuak a; puanmalngat hoih omte amu hi.
Jesu lukhung a kinulna puan pen, puanmalngat hoih lak a om lou a, atuam a khepsa a om amu hi.
Huchi in nungzui dang, han tung masazaw pen leng alut sam a, amu a, agingta hi.
Misi lak a kipan a thounawn ding ahi, chih Laisiangthou gen atheigige nawn kei uhi.
Huchi in nungzuite amau inn ah apai nawnta uhi.
Himahleh han pua ah kap kawm in Mari adingh a; kap kawm in akun a, han sung a-en hi.
heading: Mari Magdalin Kiang Ah Jesu Akilak / (Mat 28.9-10; Mar 16.9-11)

paite: Huan angel nih puanngou silh, Jesu luang sialna mun ah khat alulam leh khat akhe lam a tu amu hi.
Huan amau, "Numei, bangziak a kap na hia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka Toupa apaimangpih ua, akoihna uh ka theih louh ziak in," chi in adawng hi.
Huan huchi a agentak in anunglam anga a, Jesu dingh amu a, himahleh Jesu ahi chih athei kei hi.

Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, bangziak a kap na hia? Kua ahia na zon?" achi hi. Ama'n huanpu hiam asa a, akiang ah, "Pu, amah hiai a kipan a paimangpih na hihleh, na koihna hon hilh tanla, huchi in ka la ding,” achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Mari" achi hi. Amah akihei a, akiang ah Hebru pau in, "Rabboni" achi a, (huai tuh Sinsakpa chihna ahi).

Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hon lawng ke'n, tutan in leng Pa kiang ah ka kahtou nai kei hi. Himahleh ka unaute kiang ah va hoh inla, akiang uah, ka pa, na Pa uh, ka Pathian, na Pathian uh kiang ah ka kahtou dek, achi, va chi in," achi hi.
Mari Magdalin ava hoh a, nungzuite kiang ah, "Toupa ka muta," achi a, akiang ah hiai thute agen chih ahilhta hi.

Huan huai ni, nipikal a ni masapen, nitaklam ahong hih in, Judate kihtak ziak a nungzuite omna inn kongkhakte akhak nung un, Jesu ahong pai a, alak uah ahong dingh a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
heading: Nungzuite Kiang A Kilakna / (Mat 28.16-20; Mar 16.14-18; Luk 24.36-49)

paite: Huai agen khit in akiang uah akhut leh anak alak a, Toupa amuhtak un nungzuite akipak uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen, Pa'n kei hon sawl bang mah in nou ka hon sawl hi," achi nawn hi.
Huai thu agen khit in amau ahatkhum a, akiang uah, "Kha Siangthou tang un.
Kua khelhna leng na ngaihdam uh ngaihdam ahi ding a; kua khelhna leng na ngaihdam louh uh, ngaihdam louh ahi ding,” achi hi.
Huan Jesu ahong lai in sawm-le-nihte lak a pang sam Thomas, Didum achih uh, akiang uah a-om kei hi.
heading: Thomas Kiang A Kilakna

paite: Huchi in nungzui dangte'n akiang ah, "Toupa ka muta uh," achi uhi. Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Akhut sikkhetna pawn ka muh a, ka khutzung a ka khoih a, anak a ka khut ka golhlut hial keileh ka gingta kei ding," achi hi.

Huan ani giat nung in, insung ah anungzuite a-om nawn ua, Thomas leng akiang uah a-om sam hi. Huan kongkhakte khak hinapi in Jesu ahong pai a, alak uah ahong dinghta a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
Huan Thomas kiang ah, "Na khutzung in sawk in, ka khutte en in; na khut in khoih inla, ka nak ah sawk in; ging lou ke'nla, gingta mai in," achi hi.
Thomas in, "Ka Toupa leh ka Pathian na hi," chi in adawng hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang zaw na hon muh ziak in na gingta ahi; mu lou a gingta peuhmahte ahampha uh," achi hi.
Huan Jesu'n nungzuite ma ah chiamtehna dang tamtak ahih a, huaite hiai laibu ah gelh vek ahi kei hi.
heading: Tanchinhoih In Atup

paite: Himahleh Jesu tuh huai Khrist, Pathian Tapa ahi chih na gintakna ding uleh, na gintak ua amin a hinna na neihna ding ua gelh ahi.
